programmes.d: As a favor to a colleague, Dr. Sloan agrees to perform surgery on mafia kingpin Alfred Johnson. A supposed routine heart operation turns into an untimely death for The Don.

Carlos is working undercover to get an elusive drug dealer known as El Vaquero. He's gained the confidence of his number two Johnny Primo. Walker wants them to bust Johnny and maybe he can lead them to El Vaquero.
Trent has gained a lot of notoriety of being a defender of abused women. Now the abused wife of a criminal turns to him for help. At the same, time Walker asks for her help to get her husband.
Walker tracks down crooked geneticists who have kidnapped an important scientist whose unique DNA is vital to their research in developing super-soldiers.
A woman whom Trivette knows comes to town saying she is looking for her father and asks for his help to find him. And when he brings her to him, she pulls a gun and kills him.
Richard Kimble jeopardizes his own freedom to treat a critically ill infant.
Kimble saves the life of Maggie Tippet, the one-armed man's girlfriend.
Richard Kimble and a sheriff's girlfriend are surprised by three criminals while caring for their wounded cohort.
MacGyver takes custody of an ex-gang member accused of auto theft to save a youth center from its racist opponents.
MacGyver fights to save a young runaway from a life of drug addiction and prostitution.
MacGyver s quest to find buried Russian gold leads him through a maze of harrowing traps.

Dying of gunshot wounds, private investigator Charlie Harper whispers one final cryptic message to Dr. Sloan. Intrigued, Sloan searches for the meaning of the dying man's last words with the aid of Charlie's secretary, Georgia.

SAMMY DAVIS, JR. guest stars as a boxing trainer who helps McCall investigate a series of murders in the world of prize fighting.
